messages:
Mira Li: FYI pushed fp8-mini-v1 to the scorecard compare on staging. Seeing legend keys shifted vs actual heatmap buckets in the drilldown export :thinking_face:
Jordan C: ugh — can you paste the CSV sample? maybe the header mapping is wrong
Mira Li: sure, pasted below. export from /scorecards/compare -> Export CSV. header looks normal but values don't line up:
```
bucket_label,count,baseline_count,delta,percent_delta
0-10,42,58,-16,-27.6
10-20,101,99,2,2.0
20-30,5,3,2,66.7
```
But the UI shows 0-10 color where CSV indicates 10-20 and vice-versa when I drill in.
Devin R: could be an off-by-one in the bucket-label resolver in runner v2. We changed the bucket quantize pass last week. I'll grep for bucket_to_label in the eval-runner branch.
Alex P: +1. also check the scorecard front-end remap. I've seen index vs label mismatches before when we move from inclusive to exclusive bin edges.
Jordan C: @Devin any quick repro? I can add a CI test if we can make a minimal case.
Devin R: repro command I used locally:
```bash
python -m eval_runner.compare --run-id=2026-03-25-fp8-mini --export-csv /tmp/fp8_compare.csv --heatmap-bins "[0,10,20,30]"
```
The CSV that command emits already shows the mismatch, so the bug is pre-UI.
Mira Li: nice repro. repro CSV is attached in the thread (fp8_compare.csv). Also saw the same with a different model alias (fp8-small-checkpoint).
eval-bot: Created issue IN-1287: "bucket-label drift in compare CSV after fp8 quantize pass" and linked PR template.
Alex P: plan: 1) Devin to bisect commit that changed bin edge semantics in runner; 2) add unit test asserting label->bucket monotonic mapping; 3) add a tiny e2e in CI that runs export and diffs header->row mapping; 4) backfill fix to staging asap.
Mira Li: sounds good. I'll pin the failing CSV to the issue and add screenshots of the heatmap vs CSV colors. tagging @eng-ml for visibility :eyes:
Jordan C: Thanks — if you want I can draft the CI job change. I'll follow IN-1287 and pick up the PR review once there's a branch.
Devin R: starting bisect now. will post the commit hash by EOD.
Mira Li: great, thanks all. small impact but high UX churn for customers when exports are wrong, so priority medium-high.
